description:
Track time against threads, billable or not. Entries are stored in threads/<Kind>/<Name>/hours.md.

Subcommands:
  log [-m MIN] [-r RATE] [-c CODE] [-d DATE] [-t HH:MM] THREAD DESCRIPTION — append an entry
  list [THREAD] [--since D] [--until D] [--json] — list entries
  report [--thread T] [--since D] [--until D] [--json] — totals by thread and currency; unbilled time totalled separately
  show ID [--json] — show one entry
  edit ID [--description TEXT] [-m MIN] [-r RATE] [-c CODE] [-d DATE] [-t HH:MM] — change fields of an entry
  rm ID -y — permanently delete an entry

Args:
  THREAD / --thread T: thread name, 'Kind/Name' or wikilink.
  DESCRIPTION: short invoice line label, e.g. 'DORA metric validation'. It may span several elements, which are joined.
  ID: the entry's 8-character id, from `hours list`.
  D / DATE: YYYY-MM-DD.

Flags:
  log:
    -m, --minutes N   duration in minutes (default 60); must be positive
    -r, --rate N   hourly rate; 0 = unbillable
    -c, --currency CODE   ISO code (default: the thread's). With neither, the entry is recorded as unbilled.
    -d, --date YYYY-MM-DD   default today
    -t, --time HH:MM   start time (default now)
  list, report:
    --since D, --until D   inclusive date bounds
    --json   JSON output
  show:
    --json   JSON output
  edit:
    --description TEXT   new description
    -m, --minutes N   new duration; the start time stays the same
    -r, --rate N   new rate; needs a currency
    -c, --currency CODE   new ISO code
    -d, --date YYYY-MM-DD   move to this day; duration kept
    -t, --time HH:MM   move to this start time; duration kept
  rm:
    -y, --yes   required to confirm the delete

Examples:
  ["log", "-m", "180", "Projects/SGB", "DORA metric validation"]
  ["log", "-m", "30", "-d", "2026-09-30", "Topics/Running", "5k run"]
  ["report", "--since", "2026-09-01", "--until", "2026-09-30", "--json"]
  ["edit", "a1b2c3d4", "-m", "90"]

Notes:
  For edit, put ID first. --description takes several words and swallows any element after it that is not a flag.
  Keep descriptions short. They appear on client statements and are not searchable. Record detail with `buffer add-text`.
  log also adds a REF: line to buffer.md, filed under the entry's date.
  rm is permanent.
  Exit 1: minutes not positive, a rate with no currency, an empty description, or an entry that has a rate but no currency.
